Class Projectile

java.lang.Object
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Entity
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Projectile
Direct Known Subclasses:
CannonProjectile, RayProjectile
public abstract class Projectile extends Entity
Abstract base class for all projectiles fired by towers.

A projectile is created by a tower when it fires (via EntityFactory), then managed by the game loop each frame:

  1. update(double) moves it toward its target position.
  2. The game loop checks collision with enemies.
  3. On hit, onHit(Enemy, List) is called and the projectile is destroyed.
  4. If the projectile travels past its target without hitting anything it is also destroyed (alive becomes false in update(double)).

Projectiles target a fixed position in the world (not a moving entity reference). This avoids holding a direct reference to an enemy that might die mid-flight, which would require null checks. The projectile simply flies to where the enemy was.

This base class is purely abstract in terms of hit behaviour: it carries the shared movement (update(double)) and the shared fields, but does not define what happens on impact. Each concrete projectile family decides that for itself:

  • RayProjectile — single-target damage.
  • CannonProjectile — direct damage + area splash.

The hit behaviour is therefore declared as the abstract onHit(Enemy, List) contract.

  • Constructor Details

    • Projectile

      public Projectile(Position startPosition, Position targetPosition, double speed, int damage)
      Creates a projectile starting at startPosition, flying toward targetPosition. The size is intentionally small (visual only — collision uses a point distance check).
      Parameters:
      startPosition - the position the projectile is fired from
      targetPosition - the fixed world position the projectile flies toward
      speed - the travel speed in game-world units per second
      damage - the damage dealt on direct hit

  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update(double deltaTime)
      Moves this projectile toward its target by speed * deltaTime units per frame, destroying itself when it reaches (or overshoots) the target position.

      Subclasses can override to add curved or homing flight paths.

      Specified by:
      update in class Entity
      Parameters:
      deltaTime - the elapsed time since the previous frame, in seconds

    • onHit

      public abstract void onHit(Enemy target, List<Enemy> enemies)
      Called by the game loop when this projectile collides with an enemy.

      This is the abstract hit contract — each concrete projectile family defines its own impact behaviour (RayProjectile flat damage to the primary target only; CannonProjectile direct damage + splash to other enemies in range). The enemies list is passed so subclasses that affect an area can reach every nearby enemy without the game loop needing any projectile-type-specific code. Implementations must destroy the projectile after hitting (set alive = false / call Entity.destroy()).

      Parameters:
      target - the enemy this projectile collided with
      enemies - the full list of enemies, for area-effect projectiles
